title: List all races in 2017 and the hosting country order by date of the event.
question: List all races in 2017 and the hosting country order by date of the event.

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT 
    r.name,
    c.country
FROM races AS r
JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
WHERE r.year = 2017
ORDER BY r.month, r.day
